description: Source code for a Zephyr RTOS shell module providing LoRa radio command interface, including configuration, send, receive, and test CW functions.

methods.name: parse_long
methods.description: Parses a string argument into a long integer with error checking.

methods.name: parse_long_range
methods.description: Parses a long integer argument and checks if it falls within a specified range.

methods.name: parse_freq
methods.description: Parses a frequency string argument into a uint32_t frequency value.

methods.name: get_modem
methods.description: Retrieves the device corresponding to the default LoRa radio node.

methods.name: get_configured_modem
methods.description: Retrieves and configures the LoRa device based on current settings.

methods.name: lora_conf_set
methods.description: Sets a specific LoRa configuration parameter based on user input.

methods.name: cmd_lora_conf
methods.description: Handles the 'config' command for LoRa settings.

methods.name: cmd_lora_send
methods.description: Handles the 'send' command to transmit a LoRa packet.

methods.name: cmd_lora_recv
methods.description: Handles the 'recv' command to receive a LoRa packet.

methods.name: cmd_lora_test_cw
methods.description: Handles the 'test_cw' command to send a continuous wave.
